Roi Et sits in the middle of Isan, best known for the Ho Wot 101 observation tower rising over Bueng Phlan Chai lake in the heart of town, and the big white-and-gold Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol out in Nong Phok district. The town is laid out in a ring around Bueng Phlan Chai, so

Roi Et sits in the middle of Isan, best known for the Ho Wot 101 observation tower rising over Bueng Phlan Chai lake in the heart of town, and the big white-and-gold Phra Maha Chedi Chai Mongkol out in Nong Phok district. The town is laid out in a ring around Bueng Phlan Chai, so you can walk the lakeside, make merit at Wat Burapha Phiram, then drift between cafes and the evening market without rushing. Out past the city is Thung Kula Ronghai, the plain that grows some of the country's most famous jasmine rice. Roi Et also holds its annual Bun Phawet merit festival every March. It's a place you can visit for the culture, the Isan food, or just an easy stroll around town.
